2026-10-02 scoped host D3D9 contract evidence, stage-owned-texture-lod/native.log (not a claim of an Oblivion call-site execution): 44 successful 2D/cube/volume creation cases, 396 SetLOD/GetLOD observations. MANAGED ordinary resources clamp requested DWORD to public visible GetLevelCount-1 and return the previous value. DEFAULT/SYSTEMMEM/SCRATCH ignore writes and return/read zero. MANAGED AUTOGEN 2D/cube expose one level and clamp to zero, not hidden generated mips. After failed Reset with live DEFAULT resource: GetLOD and SetLOD return zero; requested write is ignored; successful Reset restores prior managed LOD2. Native volume AUTOGEN creation rejected. This is host-provider measurement, not universal capability proof. Owned replacement source/validation status is recorded separately.

2026-10-02 source milestone: owned public SetLOD/GetLOD now maintain atomic CPU state and publish changed controls to DX11 SRVs; no-op exchanges preserve revision. Original per-object GetLOD is used only for bootstrap inspection to avoid hook recursion; public foreign resources retain original routing. Release renderer build and four targeted checks passed: 396 native LOD observations, worker calls and 2D/cube/volume SRV mip selection with zero native LOD calls, alias reinspection, failed-Reset recovery, 193 manager checks, 109 inspection checks and 45 mip-reference comparisons (max channel error1). Undeployed; V233 remains installed. Native texture COM allocation/filter/bootstrap metadata remain dependencies. Evidence stage-owned-texture-lod.

Initial test-only whole-region normalization mismatch corrected separately. No deployment. 2026-10-02 scoped native provider contract probe stage-owned-texture-filter/native.log: 144 attempted 2D/cube/volume creations across four pools, ordinary/AUTOGEN/AUTOGEN+RT/DYNAMIC usage and A8R8G8B8/DXT1/R5G6B5; 70 successes and980 filter observations. POINT/LINEAR setters succeed even on ordinary non-AUTOGEN textures. ANISOTROPIC succeeds on 2D but rejects on cube/volume (reported filter caps 03030700/03030300/03030300). NONE and enum values4..8/99/FFFFFFFF reject without changing the stored filter. Initial filter is LINEAR except SCRATCH cube returns NONE on this provider. Failed Reset makes getter return NONE and valid/invalid setters return D3DERR_INVALIDCALL; a successful Reset restores prior managed POINT state. Measurements are host-scoped, not inferred native Oblivion calls or a universal capability proof. Native filter setter/getter still remain in production; owned migration not implemented yet.

2026-10-02 contract clarification: Microsoft SetAutoGenFilterType documentation requires the corresponding D3DPTFILTERCAPS_MINFxxx bit; source admission uses cached per-kind device caps. Docs describe non-AUTOGEN controls as no-effect/NONE, but the scoped native host probe (70 creations/980 calls) instead stores POINT/LINEAR and 2D ANISOTROPIC on ordinary resources. Migration deliberately follows the measured provider behavior here, retains bootstrap initial filter (including SCRATCH cube NONE), and records this divergence rather than asserting universal behavior. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/d3d9/nf-d3d9-idirect3dbasetexture9-setautogenfiltertype and corresponding getautogenfiltertype. Exotic capable providers/mip algorithms remain unverified.

members.comment: 2026-10-03 stage-owned-texture-mapping:1980native texture/cube/volume map cases and459surface cases. CPU2D/cube paths accept ignored hints incl tested unknown bit1, READONLY|DISCARD and bounded empty/unaligned-BC rectangles; volume and DEFAULT paths validate flags/ranges. DEFAULT ordinary textures reject locks; DYNAMIC accepts qualified maps. DEFAULT cube DISCARD rejects; dynamic2D/volume null top-level DISCARD succeeds; lower2D/cube DEFAULT DISCARD rejects. Duplicate same-subresource locks reject without breaking first Unlock; separate mips can lock together. Failed operational locks zero mapping outputs. DEFAULT standalone DONOTWAIT is valid but observed WASSTILLDRAWING while pending. RT row pitch has provider padding (64 vs owned minimum32 in8x8ARGB case), not portable fixed ABI. OwnedTextureMapping now uses Store sessions/owned row buffers, exact upload regions, CPU flag normalization, owner-supplied busy status, worker/race exclusion and reset replay; WARP pixels and legacy native-lock CPU regression pass. BeginOwnedLock rejects overlap before poisoning a lease; legacy native BeginLock remains unchanged. Empty CPU map has no write authority; out-of-bounds/reversed inputs reject. Component is not wired to live COM/factory callbacks yet. No renderer DLL build/deployment.
